observations: Photo 0 shows a metal mold block split into what appears to be two halves, laid open on a dark work surface.
Four blue/teal bottle-shaped plastic pieces sit in the mold cavities, likely sample shots left in the tool rather than part of the mold itself.
Each bottle neck has a metal collar/insert visible, consistent with a bottle-mold neck ring.
A watermark reading 'CHINYERE ASOLUKA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlays the image, indicating this is a marketplace listing photo.
No brand name, manufacturer plate, or model number is visible anywhere on the mold body.
No close-up of the cavity surface, parting line, or mold interior (ejector pins, cooling lines) is shown.
No photo of the mold closed, or of it mounted on/running in a blow-molding machine.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows four bottle-shaped impressions side by side; this is consistent with either a true 4-cavity mold or a 2-cavity mold photographed with both halves open (each cavity then shows twice). Cannot distinguish from this single angle.

risks.risk: Actual cavity count (2 vs 4) directly changes the mold's value and is not confirmed.
risks.proof: A shot of the mold fully closed from the parting line side, or a video of the two halves being brought together, showing how many true cavities exist.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value 2-cavity configuration, worst case

risks.risk: Whether the mold is functional (no cracks, no worn cavity surface, ejector pins working) cannot be judged from a static photo.
risks.proof: Close-up of the cavity surface and parting line, plus a video of the mold cycling or a sample bottle freshly shot and removed.

risks.risk: Material of construction (hardened tool steel vs. softer alloy) affects longevity and value; cannot be read from the photo.
risks.proof: Manufacturer's plate, steel grade marking, or seller's spec sheet/invoice.

risks.risk: Completeness of the set (core, cavity, neck insert, hot runner or cold runner components) is unclear; missing parts would reduce usability.
risks.proof: A photo showing all mold components laid out together, including any runner/sprue bushings.

risks.risk: Compatibility with a specific blow-molding machine (clamp size, tie-bar spacing) is not stated or shown.
risks.proof: Seller's spec sheet or a photo of the mold mounted in a machine with visible machine model/plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified compatibility, buyer bears integration risk

proof_requests: Video or photo of the mold fully closed, showing the true number of cavities from the parting line.
Close-up of the cavity interior surface for wear, pitting, or damage.
Video of the mold cycling (opening/closing) or ejecting a sample bottle.
Any manufacturer's plate, steel grade stamp, or paperwork showing specs/model.
Photo of all included components (core, cavity, neck ring, any runner parts) laid out together.
response.reason: The core value driver for this item, the real cavity count, is ambiguous from a single open-mold photo and the seller's 'two cavity' claim is unconfirmed; without a closed-mold or cycling shot even a worst-case price tier cannot be fixed.
